callback_source_form.instructions: Which proposed source form A,B,C or D is the smallest complete fit for this verified original lifecycle requirement? Compare source authority, exact owning correspondence, recovery permission costs, type/presentation completeness and implementation burden equally. Existing APIs and advice do not make a proposal accepted or release the private-source hold.

A.choice: Explicit virtual delivery selector with existing policy form
A.surface: Introduce one compiler-owned nonstored typed request.callback_diagnostics property for only the supported declared generation bindings. Use existing policy Run read=<ordinary or recovery formula> fields=request.callback_diagnostics rows; these exact explicit leaf grants alone lower separate callbackPolicy with fields=[], by/when. Existing all-fields/whole request/error/progress grants do not implicitly authorize this extra protected diagnostic surface. Source reads row.request?.callback_diagnostics as a whole existing owning closed result. No new grammar, app field/table or runtime DTO.
A.benefit: Concise owning association, typed direct page selection and familiar policy authoring; complete identity/current-parent/revalidation checks continue in State.
A.cost: New virtual type/property and explicit protected-selector exception to ordinary parent-grant/default-all behavior must be accepted and documented; Compiler/native must distinguish this grant from ordinary field projection and propagate exact source correspondence.

B.choice: Dedicated callback read declaration plus typed delivery selection
B.surface: Introduce a separate source declaration on the owning Run.request, spelled provisionally callback_read Run.request by=<reader> when=<row predicate>, with exact checked generation operation/progressed/ordinary-handler scope derived from that field. It lowers the separate empty-fields callbackPolicy; source still needs a new typed virtual callback_diagnostics selection. Ordinary and safe-recovery grants are authored independently and combine only for that target.
B.benefit: Authority visibly separate from ordinary data policies, no exception to existing policy default-all or parent-selector semantics; no app storage or generic failure directory.
B.cost: Adds a new declaration/grammar/checker/emitter surface alongside existing policy read/where/fields and a new typed selection; more authoring and maintenance. Precise by/when, duplicate/union/missing grant semantics and supported scope must be defined before implementation.

C.choice: Explicit owning read report through existing scenario form
C.surface: Use a described scenario callback_diagnostics(run:Run) by=<reader> read=true scope=authority returning the owning closed result, with source-authored ordinary or recovery admission checks. Add a bounded pure callback-diagnostic expression tied to that checked run.request; its checked report authority supplies the separate callbackPolicy and never bypasses State identity/parent fences. UI invokes only this typed read operation.
C.benefit: Reuses an existing explicit information-grant declaration and gives diagnostic output its own described public read boundary; no special ordinary field grant or stored app field.
C.cost: Still needs a new native-backed pure expression and checked report-to-callback policy correspondence; more function/argument/UI invocation boilerplate for these associated values and a report boundary potentially larger than one delivery leaf. Existing authority report is not by itself an implemented producer.

criteria.D: None is sufficiently justified. Preserve refusal and request one exact missing source-owner decision or evidence; do not invent automatic authority or weaken existing parent/current source/fence semantics.
